body.x: The hottest new items in smartphone accessories – CardNinja – which is a new alternative to traditional wallet and will be display at table #G17, CES 2013, Las Vegas.

CardNinja is created to help men and women simplify their lives by streamlining what they carry. CardNinja is an ultra-thin, unique way to securely hold credit/debit/ID cards and cash on the back of your phone, making it a convenient alternative to a bulky wallet.

The CardNinja ($17.99):Attaches easily like a sticker , Removable , Holds valuables securely, Flexible enough to hold cash and up to eight credit or ID cards, Available in ninja black, steel, and eggplant colors.You can find more details at www.cardninja.com
